title: Reject retirement of an already-retired card
fix: Retirement returns the existing retired path without rewriting or unlinking it.

title: Quote scanned paths as literal shell arguments
fix: Scan commands use shlex.quote on resolved absolute paths; executable and argument remain separate shell tokens.

title: Refuse to overwrite another card during moves
fix: Lifecycle moves validate source snapshots and refuse destination collisions under the inventory lock; wiki edit/share checks the destination before saving.

title: Make card updates transactional across CLI and wiki
fix: Shared reentrant flock/RLock transactions, exact raw preimage validation, locked inventory reads, atomic fsync/replace writes, and friendly CLI/HTTP conflicts. Lifecycle source removal and destination rollback use durable, exclusive-rename claims; claimed inodes are retained and actual captured identities and contents are validated.

title: Preserve the current external version before every mutation
fix: ensure_base compares every on-disk preimage with the last history text before any supported mutation.

title: Make frontmatter encoding and parsing lossless
fix: In-memory quote-aware parsing and symmetric JSON string/list encoding retain quotes, commas, comments, backslashes, whitespace, and line endings; legacy plain/comment cards remain readable.

title: Validate card IDs before constructing history paths
fix: History path construction validates the documented ID format and checks resolved path containment, including symlinks.

title: Repair unterminated history tails before appending
fix: Locked atomic history replacement preserves valid unterminated entries and quarantines incomplete tails, including partial UTF-8; complete corrupt records and invalid writer fields fail closed.

title: Parse revision text without a shared temporary file
fix: Revision rendering uses core.parse_text in memory and never writes rev.md.

title: Merge check results atomically across processes
fix: Checks run outside the inventory lock, then merge only accepted updates into fresh state atomically; blocked wiki results never enter the commit.

title: Bind edit conflict tokens to the rendered snapshot
fix: The edit token is derived from the parsed card's retained raw snapshot; conflict checking and saving occur under the common transaction lock.

title: Drain active mutations before stopping the server
fix: Server admission tracks accepted mutations and snapshot history-sync writes, rejects new writers when stopping, and drains accepted writers without waiting for idle request readers.

title: Create parent directories for personal-card destinations
fix: All lifecycle/new-card destination directory creation includes parents=True.

title: Preserve comma-containing titles in related-page forms
fix: Related-page form values retain stable IDs; complete comma-containing titles resolve before CSV parsing, with quoted CSV names supported.

title: Reject title collisions when renaming pages
fix: A locked fresh namespace check rejects title/alias/ID/slug ownership collisions on saves, renames, creation, and historical restore; unique renames retain the old title as an alias.

title: Terminate check descendants when a timeout expires
fix: Each check starts a process group; timeout sends group TERM followed by bounded group KILL and reaps the shell.

title: Validate requests against the server's bound port
fix: Host/Origin checks and health responses use server_port, not mutable config. Socket-bound metadata enables old-port discovery, restart, and stop; stop waits for process exit and reports drain timeout accurately.

title: Honor the no-check option before executing commands
fix: --no-check prevents automatic and explicit --check execution on both map and today.

title: Handle empty inventories and scan results
fix: Display width calculations use defaults for empty active inventories and empty scan results.

title: Split editor commands into executable and arguments
fix: EDITOR is split with shlex.split; the card path is appended as a distinct argument.

title: Seed the interactive new-card form from supplied flags
fix: Every interactive field is initialized from parsed flags and --link survives form submission.

title: Bound directory traversal before materializing file paths
fix: A lazy file iterator is capped with islice before Path-list materialization and prunes dependency/cache directories.

title: Retain personal directories in generated Markdown links
fix: Markdown targets derive from the complete root-relative card path with only the extension removed.

title: Associate recent Git changes across filename renames
fix: Recent events use per-card git log --follow, retaining association through multiple filename renames.

title: Resolve complete page names before stripping path prefixes
fix: Resolution tries the complete name first and only strips a recognized cards/inbox/retired path prefix as a fallback.

title: Invalidate pending suggestions when dismissing search
fix: Clear/Escape/outside dismissal invalidate sequence tokens and pending timers; responses recheck sequence after fetch and after JSON completion.
